records.signature: sco_result (*)(sco_plugin *, const char *, uint64_t, const double *, const double *, uint64_t *)
records.purpose: Canonical ObjectContainers content-relative .socpak path (511 bytes max), finite zone-local pose and normalized quaternion. Caller-owned final entity ID, zero on failure; success means spawn initiation only. Shared 1024 owned quota and 128 own entities maximum, checked before mutation. Pending prefab ownership is never pruned by alive=0. Capability game.entities.prefabs remains OFF pending owner streamed spawn/unload acceptance.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*spawn)(sco_plugin* self, const char* content_path, uint64_t zone_id, const double pos[3], const double rot_xyzw[4], uint64_t* out_id);`
Canonical ObjectContainers content-relative .socpak path (511 bytes max), finite zone-local pose and normalized quaternion. Caller-owned final entity ID, zero on failure; success means spawn initiation only. Shared 1024 owned quota and 128 own entities maximum, checked before mutation. Pending prefab ownership is never pruned by alive=0. Capability game.entities.prefabs remains OFF pending owner streamed spawn/unload acceptance.
records.ownership: Live caller owns result through existing game.entities ledger. Inputs copied for synchronous provider call, host-session table borrowed; no cross-boundary allocation.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks. Host-only provider callbacks synchronous, bounded and nonthrowing.
records.reentrancy: No recursive reentry; host adapter must not call plugins.
records.results: BAD_ARG invalid handle/path/pose/output; WRONG_THREAD; TOO_MANY quota; NOT_FOUND zone/content/class; UNAVAILABLE disabled capability or cleanup; FAILED provider refusal/fault. Output ID zero on failure.
records.absent_capability: Absent service: query_service NOT_FOUND; present disabled operation: UNAVAILABLE.
records.cleanup: Use existing entities despawn/set_transform and game.owned retention/removal. Ordinary owner unload removes pending/streamed owned prefab via delayed removal primitive; no materialization/removal completion promise. Known ID on provider failure remains tracked for cleanup. Fault-retained native provider follows restart-required lifetime contract.
limitations: Windows engine/SEH/gameplay and streamed cleanup not verified.
Production capability OFF until owner acceptance; portable provider policy is synthetic evidence only.
No packaged content or filesystem/online path access.
